observableRefreshState.blocker: The five-minute OpenCode cache `loadedAt` value is module-private; the public picker does not expose lastVerifiedAt; and DevConsole records catalog, status, and session calls under the same `opencode_server_request` label without the native route kind. The non-specific transport count/timestamps cannot prove a catalog refresh. A five-minute wait would therefore be unprovable without new product telemetry or request-body interception that is not part of the public evidence contract.
